legend-north-coast-500.slogan: North Coast 500 – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-north-coast-500.story: A loop of the Scottish Highlands from Inverness. A one-way ride of 487 km, Inverness to Inverness - roughly 8 h 51 in the saddle. On the way it passes North Coast 500, Ullapool and Golspie. The line favours views over speed.

scenicChapters.title: North Coast 500
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 4 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

legend-north-coast-500.storyWas: A loop of the Scottish Highlands from Inverness.
